A cat(1) clone with syntax highlighting and Git integration.

## Key Features ### Syntax highlighting `bat` supports syntax highlighting for a large number of programming and markup languages. ### Git integration `bat` communicates with `git` to show modifications with respect to the index. ### Show non-printable characters You can use the `-A`/`--show-all` option to show and highlight non-printable characters. ### Automatic paging By default, `bat` pipes its own output to a pager (e.g. `less`) if the output is too large for one screen. If you would rather `bat` work like `cat` all the time (never page output), you can set `--paging=never` as an option, either on the command line or in your configuration file. If you intend to alias `cat` to `bat` in your shell configuration, you can use `alias cat='bat --paging=never'` to preserve the default behavior. #### File concatenation Even with a pager set, you can still use `bat` to concatenate files. Whenever `bat` detects a non-interactive terminal (i.e. when you pipe into another process or into a file), `bat` will act as a drop-in replacement for `cat` and fall back to printing the plain file contents, regardless of the `--pager` option's value. ## How to use Display a single file on the terminal: ```bash bat README.md ``` Display multiple files at once: ```bash bat src/*.rs ``` Read from stdin, determine the syntax automatically: ```bash curl -s https://sh.rustup.rs | bat ``` Read from stdin, specify the language explicitly: ```bash yaml2json .travis.yml | json_pp | bat -l json ``` Show and highlight non-printable characters: ```bash bat -A /etc/hosts ``` Use it as a `cat` replacement: ```bash bat > note.md # quickly create a new file bat header.md content.md footer.md > document.md bat -n main.rs # show line numbers (only) bat f - g # output 'f', then stdin, then 'g'. ``` ### Integration with other tools #### `fzf` You can use `bat` as a previewer for `fzf`: ```bash fzf --preview "bat --color=always --style=numbers --line-range=:500 {}" ``` #### `find` or `fd` Preview all search results with `bat`: ```bash find … -exec bat {} + fd … -X bat ``` #### `ripgrep` With `batgrep`, `bat` can be used as the printer for `ripgrep` search results: ```bash batgrep needle src/ ``` #### `tail -f` `bat` can be combined with `tail -f` to continuously monitor a given file with syntax highlighting: ```bash tail -f /var/log/pacman.log | bat --paging=never -l log ``` #### `git` Combine `bat` with `git show` to view an older version of a file with syntax highlighting: ```bash git show v0.6.0:src/main.rs | bat -l rs ``` #### `git diff` Combine `bat` with `git diff` to view lines around code changes: ```bash batdiff() { git diff --name-only --relative --diff-filter=d -z | xargs -0 bat --diff } ``` #### `xclip` Pipe the output into `xclip` to copy file contents: ```bash bat main.cpp | xclip ``` `bat` will detect that the output is being redirected and print the plain file contents. #### `man` `bat` can be used as a colorizing pager for `man`: ```bash export MANPAGER="bat -plman" man 2 select ``` #### Highlighting `--help` messages You can use `bat` to colorize help text: ```bash cp --help | bat -plhelp ``` Or use a wrapper: ```bash alias bathelp='bat --plain --language=help' help() { "$@" --help 2>&1 | bathelp } ``` ## Installation Download prebuilt binaries from the release page for your platform. `bat` is also available through various package managers: - Ubuntu/Debian: `sudo apt install bat` - Alpine: `apk add bat` - Arch: `pacman -S bat` - Fedora: `dnf install bat` - Gentoo: `emerge sys-apps/bat` - FreeBSD: `pkg install bat` - OpenBSD: `pkg_add bat` - Nix: `nix-env -i bat` - openSUSE: `zypper install bat` - macOS (Homebrew): `brew install bat` - macOS (MacPorts): `port install bat` - Windows (WinGet): `winget install sharkdp.bat` - Windows (Chocolatey): `choco install bat` - Windows (Scoop): `scoop install bat` ## Customization ### Highlighting theme Use `bat --list-themes` to get a list of all available themes for syntax highlighting. To select a theme, use the `--theme` option: ```bash bat --theme=TwoDark myfile.txt ``` Or set the `BAT_THEME` environment variable: ```bash export BAT_THEME="TwoDark" ``` `bat` automatically picks a fitting theme depending on your terminal's background color. You can use the `--theme-dark` / `--theme-light` options or the `BAT_THEME_DARK` / `BAT_THEME_LIGHT` environment variables to customize the themes used. ### Output style Use the `--style` option to control the appearance of `bat`'s output: ```bash bat --style=numbers,changes myfile.txt ``` Set the `BAT_STYLE` environment variable to make these changes permanent. ### Decorations By default, `bat` only shows decorations when outputting to an interactive terminal. Control this with the `--decorations` option: ```bash bat --decorations=always myfile.txt # always show decorations bat --decorations=never myfile.txt # never show decorations ``` ### Using a different pager `bat` uses the pager specified in the `PAGER` environment variable. If not set, `less` is used by default. You can also use bat's built-in pager with `--pager=builtin`. To use a different pager: ```bash export BAT_PAGER="less -RF" ``` ### Configuration file `bat` can be customized with a configuration file. To get the default path: ```bash bat --config-file ``` Generate a default configuration file: ```bash bat --generate-config-file ``` The configuration file is a simple list of command line arguments. Example: ```bash # Set the theme --theme="TwoDark" # Show line numbers, Git modifications and file header --style="numbers,changes,header" # Use C++ syntax for Arduino .ino files --map-syntax "*.ino:C++" ``` ## Command-line options For a full list of options, run: ```bash bat --help ``` ## Project goals `bat` tries to achieve the following goals: - Provide beautiful, advanced syntax highlighting - Integrate with Git to show file modifications - Be a drop-in replacement for (POSIX) `cat` - Offer a user-friendly command-line interface ## License Copyright (c) 2018-2025 bat-developers `bat` is made available under the terms of either the MIT License or the Apache License 2.0, at your option. # shellcheck disable=SC2207

# Requires https://github.com/scop/bash-completion

# Macs have bash3 for which the bash-completion package doesn't include
# _init_completion. This is a minimal version of that function.
__bat_init_completion()
{
	COMPREPLY=()
	_get_comp_words_by_ref "$@" cur prev words cword
}

__bat_escape_completions()
{
	# Do not escape if completing a quoted value.
	[[ $cur == [\"\']* ]] && return 0
	if ((
		BASH_VERSINFO[0] > 5 || \
		BASH_VERSINFO[0] == 5 && BASH_VERSINFO[1] >= 3
	)); then
		# bash >= 5.3 has "compopt -o fullquote", which exactly does
		# what this function tries to do.
		compopt -o fullquote
	elif ((
		BASH_VERSINFO[0] > 4 || \
		BASH_VERSINFO[0] == 4 && BASH_VERSINFO[1] > 0
	)); then
		# printf -v to an array index is available in bash >= 4.1.
		# Use it if available, as -o filenames is semantically
		# incorrect if we are not actually completing filenames, and it
		# has side effects (e.g. adds trailing slash to candidates
		# matching present dirs).
		local i
		for i in ${!COMPREPLY[*]}; do
			printf -v "COMPREPLY[i]" %q "${COMPREPLY[i]}"
		done

		# We can use "compopt -o noquote" available in bash >= 4.3 to
		# prevent further quoting by the shell, which would be
		# unexpectedly applied when a quoted result matches a filename.
		if ((
			BASH_VERSINFO[0] > 4 || \
			BASH_VERSINFO[0] == 4 && BASH_VERSINFO[1] >= 3
		)); then
			compopt -o noquote
		fi
	else
		compopt -o filenames
	fi
}

_bat() {
	local cur prev words split=false
	if declare -F _init_completion >/dev/null 2>&1; then
		_init_completion -s || return 0
	else
		__bat_init_completion -n "=" || return 0
		_split_longopt && split=true
	fi

	if [[ ${words[1]-} == cache ]]; then
		case $prev in
		--source | --target)
			_filedir -d
			return 0
			;;
		esac
		COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "
			--build
			--clear
			--source
			--target
			--blank
			--help
		" -- "$cur"))
		return 0
	fi

	case $prev in
	-l | --language)
		local IFS=$'\n'
		COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$(
			"$1" --list-languages | while IFS=: read -r lang _; do
				printf "%s\n" "$lang"
			done
		)" -- "$cur"))
		__bat_escape_completions
		return 0
		;;
	-H | --highlight-line | \
	--diff-context | \
	--tabs | \
	--terminal-width | \
	-m | --map-syntax | \
	--ignored-suffix | \
	--list-themes | \
	--squeeze-limit | \
	--line-range | \
	-L | --list-languages | \
	--lessopen | \
</output>

Register-ArgumentCompleter -Native -CommandName 'bat' -ScriptBlock {
    param($wordToComplete, $commandAst, $cursorPosition)

    $ArrayStyle      = @('default', 'auto', 'full', 'plain', 'changes', 'header', 'header-filename', 'header-filesize', 'grid', 'rule', 'numbers', 'snip')
    $ArrayCompletion = @('bash', 'fish', 'zsh', 'ps1')
    $ArrayWhen       = @('auto', 'never', 'always')
    $ArrayYesNo      = @('never', 'always')
    $ArrayWrap       = @('always', 'never', 'character', 'word')
    $ArrayBinary     = @('no-printing', 'as-text')
    $ArrayPrint      = @('unicode', 'caret')

    function Get-MyThemes(){
        $themes = bat --list-themes | ForEach-Object {$_  -replace "^(.*)$", '''$1'''} | select-object
        return $themes
    }

    function Get-MyLanguages(){
        $themes = bat --list-languages | ForEach-Object{[pscustomobject]@{MyParameter=$_.Substring(0,$_.IndexOf(":")).Trim();MyDescription=$_.Substring($_.IndexOf(":")+1)}} | select-object
        return $themes
    }

    $commandElements = $commandAst.CommandElements
    $command = @(
        'bat'
        for ($i = 1; $i -lt $commandElements.Count; $i++) {
            $element = $commandElements[$i]
            if ($element -isnot [StringConstantExpressionAst] -or
                $element.StringConstantType -ne [StringConstantType]::BareWord -or

                break
        }
        $element.Value
    }) -join ';'

        '*;--help' {
            break

        '*;--version' {
            break

        '*;--language' {

            }
            break

            Get-MyThemes |
            ForEach-Object {[System.Management.Automation.CompletionResult]::new($_, $_, [CompletionResultType]::ParameterName, $_)}
            break

        '*;--binary' {

# Error helpers
def fatal_missing(flag, placeholder):
    sys.stderr.write(f"error: a value is required for '--{flag} {placeholder}' but none was supplied\n")
    sys.exit(2)
def fatal_invalid(flag, placeholder, val, hint=None, hint2=None):
    sys.stderr.write(f"error: invalid value '{val}' for '--{flag} {placeholder}'")
    if hint:
        sys.stderr.write(f": {hint}\n")
    else:
        sys.stderr.write("\n")
    if hint2:
        sys.stderr.write(f"  {hint2}\n")
    sys.exit(2)
def fatal_unknown_long(name):
    prog=os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]) or "executable"
    sys.stderr.write(f"error: unexpected argument '--{name}' found\n")
    sys.stderr.write(f"\n  tip: to pass '--{name}' as a value, use '-- --{name}'\n")
    sys.stderr.write(f"\nUsage: {prog} [OPTIONS] [FILE]...\n       {prog} <COMMAND>\n")
    sys.exit(2)
def fatal_unknown_short(ch):
    prog=os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]) or "executable"
    sys.stderr.write(f"error: unexpected argument '-{ch}' found\n")
    sys.stderr.write(f"\nUsage: {prog} [OPTIONS] [FILE]...\n       {prog} <COMMAND>\n")
    sys.exit(2)
def fatal_conflict(arg, other):
    prog=os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]) or "executable"
    sys.stderr.write(f"error: the argument '{arg}' cannot be used with '{other}'\n")
    sys.stderr.write(f"\nUsage: {prog} {arg} <FILE>...\n")
    sys.exit(2)

def handle_cache(args):
    # simplified earlier logic but need to handle help printing exact text

    i=0
    build=False; clear=False; source=None; target=None; blank=False; ack=False; help_req=False

        a=args[i]
        if a in ("-h","--help"):
            help_req=True; i+=1
        elif a in ("-b","--build"):
            build=True; i+=1
        elif a in ("-c","--clear"):
            clear=True; i+=1
        elif a == "--blank":
            blank=True; i+=1
        elif a == "--acknowledgements":
            ack=True; i+=1
        elif a == "--source":
            if i+1>=len(args):
                sys.stderr.write("error: a value is required for '--source <dir>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
            source=args[i+1]; i+=2
        elif a.startswith("--source="):
            source=a.split("=",1)[1]; i+=1
        elif a == "--target":
            if i+1>=len(args):
                sys.stderr.write("error: a value is required for '--target <dir>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
            target=args[i+1]; i+=2
        elif a.startswith("--target="):
            target=a.split("=",1)[1]; i+=1
        else:
            sys.stderr.write(f"error: unexpected argument '{a}' found\n\nUsage: executable cache [OPTIONS]\n")
            sys.exit(2)
    if help_req or (not build and not clear):
        txt="""Modify the syntax-definition and theme cache

Usage: executable cache [OPTIONS]

Options:

          Print help

  -b, --build
          Initialize (or update) the syntax/theme cache by loading from the source directory

  -c, --clear
          Remove the cached syntax definitions and themes.

      --source <dir>
          Use a different directory to load syntaxes and themes from.

      --target <dir>
          Use a different directory to store the cached syntax and theme set.

      --blank
          Create completely new syntax and theme sets (instead of appending to the default sets).

      --acknowledgements
          Build acknowledgements.bin."""
        sys.stdout.write(txt+"\n")
        sys.exit(0)
    if blank and not build:
        sys.stderr.write("error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  --build\n\nUsage: executable cache --build --blank\n")
        sys.exit(2)
    if ack and not build:
        sys.stderr.write("error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  --build\n\nUsage: executable cache --build --acknowledgements\n")
        sys.exit(2)
    if build and clear:
        sys.stderr.write("error: the argument '--build' cannot be used with '--clear'\n")
        sys.exit(2)
    cache_dir = target or get_cache_dir()
    source_dir = source or get_config_dir()
    cache_path=pathlib.Path(cache_dir)
    source_path=pathlib.Path(source_dir)
    if clear:
        sys.stdout.write("Clearing theme set cache ... okay\n")
        sys.stdout.write("Clearing syntax set cache ... okay\n")
        sys.stdout.write("Clearing metadata file ... okay\n")
        try:
            for f in ["themes.bin","syntaxes.bin","metadata.yaml"]:
                fp=cache_path/f
                if fp.exists():
                    fp.unlink()
        except: pass
        sys.exit(0)
    if build:
        cache_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        theme_src=source_path/"themes"
        syntax_src=source_path/"syntaxes"
        # check if theme source empty

def get_config_file_path():
    bat_config = os.environ.get("BAT_CONFIG_PATH")
    if bat_config:
        return bat_config
    xdg = os.environ.get("XDG_CONFIG_HOME")
    if xdg:
        return os.path.join(xdg, "bat", "config")
    return os.path.expanduser("~/.config/bat/config")

def get_config_dir():
    bat_config = os.environ.get("BAT_CONFIG_PATH")
    if bat_config:
        d=os.path.dirname(bat_config)
        return d if d else "."
    xdg = os.environ.get("XDG_CONFIG_HOME")
    if xdg:
        return os.path.join(xdg, "bat")
    return os.path.expanduser("~/.config/bat")

def get_cache_dir():
    bat_cache = os.environ.get("BAT_CACHE_PATH")
    if bat_cache:
        return bat_cache
    xdg = os.environ.get("XDG_CACHE_HOME")
    if xdg:
        return os.path.join(xdg, "bat")
    return os.path.expanduser("~/.cache/bat")

# Error helpers
def fatal_missing(flag, placeholder):
    sys.stderr.write(f"error: a value is required for '--{flag} {placeholder}' but none was supplied\n")
    sys.exit(2)
def fatal_invalid(flag, placeholder, val, hint=None, hint2=None):
    sys.stderr.write(f"error: invalid value '{val}' for '--{flag} {placeholder}'")
    if hint:
        sys.stderr.write(f": {hint}\n")
    else:
        sys.stderr.write("\n")
    if hint2:
        sys.stderr.write(f"  {hint2}\n")
    sys.exit(2)
def fatal_unknown_long(name):
    prog=os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]) or "executable"
    sys.stderr.write(f"error: unexpected argument '--{name}' found\n")
    sys.stderr.write(f"\n  tip: to pass '--{name}' as a value, use '-- --{name}'\n")
    sys.stderr.write(f"\nUsage: {prog} [OPTIONS] [FILE]...\n       {prog} <COMMAND>\n")
    sys.exit(2)
def fatal_unknown_short(ch):
    prog=os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]) or "executable"
    sys.stderr.write(f"error: unexpected argument '-{ch}' found\n")
    sys.stderr.write(f"\nUsage: {prog} [OPTIONS] [FILE]...\n       {prog} <COMMAND>\n")
    sys.exit(2)
def fatal_conflict(arg, other):
    prog=os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]) or "executable"
    sys.stderr.write(f"error: the argument '{arg}' cannot be used with '{other}'\n")
    sys.stderr.write(f"\nUsage: {prog} {arg} <FILE>...\n")
    sys.exit(2)

            if "=" in arg:
                name,val = arg[2:].split("=",1)

                name=arg[2:]; val=None
            # aliases
            if name == "fallback-language":
                name="fallback-syntax"

            if name in LONG_WITH_VALUE:
                placeholder=PLACEHOLDERS.get(name, f"<{name}>")
                if val is None:
                    if i+1 >= len(args) or (args[i+1].startswith("-") and args[i+1] not in ("-","--")):

                    val=args[i+1]; i+=2
                else:
                    i+=1

                        # need hint2 for possible values
                        poss=", ".join(ENUM_VALUES[name])
                        fatal_invalid(name, placeholder, val, None, f"[possible values: {poss}]")
                if name == "style":
                    parts=val.split(",")
                    for p in parts:
                        core=p.lstrip("+-")
                        if core not in STYLE_COMPONENTS:
                            fatal_invalid(name, placeholder, val, f"Unknown style '{val}'")
                    opts["style"].append(val)

                    if not re.match(r'^[+-]?\d+$', val):
                        fatal_invalid(name, placeholder, val, "must be an offset or number")

                elif name == "squeeze-limit":
                    try:
                        iv=int(val)
                        if iv<0: raise
                        opts["squeeze-limit"]=iv
                    except:
                        fatal_invalid(name, placeholder, val, "Requires a non-negative number")
                elif name == "diff-context":
                    try:
                        iv=int(val)
                        opts["diff-context"]=iv
                    except:
                        fatal_invalid(name, placeholder, val, "must be a number")
                elif name == "line-range":
                    opts["line-range"].append(val)
                elif name == "highlight-line":
                    opts["highlight-line"].append(val)
                elif name == "map-syntax":
                    opts["map-syntax"].append(val)
                elif name == "language":
                    opts["language"]=val
                elif name == "fallback-syntax":
                    opts["fallback-syntax"]=val
                elif name == "file-name":
                    opts["file-name"]=val
                elif name == "ignored-suffix":

                elif name == "theme":

                elif name == "theme-light":

                elif name == "theme-dark":

                elif name == "pager":
                    opts["pager"]=val
                elif name == "completion":
                    if val not in ENUM_VALUES["completion"]:
                        poss=", ".join(ENUM_VALUES["completion"])
                        fatal_invalid(name, placeholder, val, None, f"[possible values: {poss}]")
                    opts["completion"]=val
                elif name in ENUM_VALUES:
                    opts[name]=val
                else:
                    opts[name]=val
                continue
            elif name in LONG_NO_VALUE:
                if "=" in arg:

                if name == "help":

                elif name == "version":

                elif name == "show-all":

                elif name == "unbuffered":

                elif name == "diagnostic":

                elif name == "quiet-empty":

                elif name == "acknowledgements":
                    opts["acknowledgements"]=True
                elif name == "set-terminal-title":
                    opts["set-terminal-title"]=True
                elif name == "config-file":
                    opts["config-file"]=True
                elif name == "config-dir":

                elif name == "cache-dir":

        elif arg.startswith("-") and arg != "-":
            flags=arg[1:]
            pos=0
            while pos < len(flags):
                f=flags[pos]

                long_name=SHORT_MAP[f]

                            ph=PLACEHOLDERS.get(long_name, "<value>")

                        val=args[i+1]; i+=1
                    if long_name=="language":
                        opts["language"]=val
                    elif long_name=="highlight-line":
                        opts["highlight-line"].append(val)
                    elif long_name=="map-syntax":
                        opts["map-syntax"].append(val)
                    elif long_name=="line-range":
                        opts["line-range"].append(val)
                    break
                else:
                    if f=="p":
                        opts["plain"]+=1
                    elif f=="A":
                        opts["show-all"]=True
                    elif f=="d":
                        opts["diff"]=True
                    elif f=="S":
                        opts["wrap"]="never"; opts["chop-long-lines"]=True
                    elif f=="n":
                        opts["number"]=True
                    elif f=="f":
                        opts["force-colorization"]=True
                    elif f=="s":
                        opts["squeeze-blank"]=True
                    elif f=="L":
                        opts["list-languages"]=True
                    elif f=="u":
                        opts["unbuffered"]=True
                    elif f=="E":
                        opts["quiet-empty"]=True
                    elif f=="h":
                        opts["help"]=True
                    elif f=="V":

                    elif f=="P":

                    elif f=="b":

                    pos+=1
            i+=1

        else:
            files.append(arg); i+=1
    # conflict checks
    if opts["force-colorization"]:
        if opts["color"] != "auto":
            fatal_conflict("--force-colorization","--color <when>")
        if opts["decorations"] != "auto":
            fatal_conflict("--force-colorization","--decorations <when>")
    return opts, files

def handle_cache(args):
    # simplified earlier logic but need to handle help printing exact text
    # handle options
    i=0
    build=False; clear=False; source=None; target=None; blank=False; ack=False; help_req=False
    while i < len(args):
        a=args[i]
        if a in ("-h","--help"):
            help_req=True; i+=1
        elif a in ("-b","--build"):
            build=True; i+=1
        elif a in ("-c","--clear"):
            clear=True; i+=1
        elif a == "--blank":
            blank=True; i+=1
        elif a == "--acknowledgements":
            ack=True; i+=1
        elif a == "--source":
            if i+1>=len(args):
                sys.stderr.write("error: a value is required for '--source <dir>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
            source=args[i+1]; i+=2
        elif a.startswith("--source="):
            source=a.split("=",1)[1]; i+=1
        elif a == "--target":
            if i+1>=len(args):
                sys.stderr.write("error: a value is required for '--target <dir>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
            target=args[i+1]; i+=2
        elif a.startswith("--target="):
            target=a.split("=",1)[1]; i+=1
        else:
            sys.stderr.write(f"error: unexpected argument '{a}' found\n\nUsage: executable cache [OPTIONS]\n")
            sys.exit(2)
    if help_req or (not build and not clear):
        txt="""Modify the syntax-definition and theme cache

Usage: executable cache [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help

  -b, --build
          Initialize (or update) the syntax/theme cache by loading from the source directory
          (default: the configuration directory).

  -c, --clear
          Remove the cached syntax definitions and themes.

      --source <dir>
          Use a different directory to load syntaxes and themes from.

      --target <dir>
          Use a different directory to store the cached syntax and theme set.

      --blank
          Create completely new syntax and theme sets (instead of appending to the default sets).

      --acknowledgements
          Build acknowledgements.bin."""
        sys.stdout.write(txt+"\n")
        sys.exit(0)
    if blank and not build:
        sys.stderr.write("error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  --build\n\nUsage: executable cache --build --blank\n")
        sys.exit(2)
    if ack and not build:
        sys.stderr.write("error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  --build\n\nUsage: executable cache --build --acknowledgements\n")
        sys.exit(2)
    if build and clear:
        sys.stderr.write("error: the argument '--build' cannot be used with '--clear'\n")
        sys.exit(2)
    cache_dir = target or get_cache_dir()
    source_dir = source or get_config_dir()
    cache_path=pathlib.Path(cache_dir)
    source_path=pathlib.Path(source_dir)
    if clear:
        sys.stdout.write("Clearing theme set cache ... okay\n")
        sys.stdout.write("Clearing syntax set cache ... okay\n")
        sys.stdout.write("Clearing metadata file ... okay\n")
        try:
            for f in ["themes.bin","syntaxes.bin","metadata.yaml"]:
                fp=cache_path/f
                if fp.exists():
                    fp.unlink()
        except: pass
        sys.exit(0)
    if build:
        cache_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        theme_src=source_path/"themes"
        syntax_src=source_path/"syntaxes"
        # check if theme source empty
        has_theme=False
        if theme_src.exists():
            try:
                has_theme=any(theme_src.iterdir())
            except: has_theme=False
        if not has_theme:
            sys.stdout.write(f"No themes were found in '{source_dir}/themes', using the default set\n")
        has_syntax=False
        if syntax_src.exists():
            try:
                has_syntax=any(syntax_src.iterdir())
            except: has_syntax=False
        if not has_syntax:
            sys.stdout.write(f"No syntaxes were found in '{source_dir}/syntaxes', using the default set.\n")
